doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.titleZh: 乙醇与CO₂的碳汇聚协同利用实现Komagataella phaffii中3-羟基丙酸的高效生物合成
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.abstractZh: 摘要：CO₂是一种丰富的生物制造原料，但其高氧化态使多碳化合物的生物合成需要大量还原力。本研究在工程化Komagataella phaffii中建立了一种碳汇聚策略，通过协同利用乙醇和无机碳生产3-羟基丙酸（3-HP）。乙醇作为枢纽分子，在提供得以保留的C2骨架的同时提供还原当量，从而通过并入无机C1碳，实现通向3-HP的“2+1=3”路线。通过协同改造乙醇同化、乙酸活化、羧化、辅因子供应及能量代谢，研究者获得了LT-28菌株，其3-HP滴度达到127.04 g/L，是迄今报道的基于CO₂生物合成的最高滴度。¹³C示踪证实，乙醇来源的C2碳和无机C1碳共同参与构成产物骨架。LT-28还将来自CO₂热催化还原的、未经纯化的富乙醇物料流转化为3-HP。这些发现证明，通过乙醇介导的碳汇聚，将CO₂化学还原与微生物3-HP生物合成相耦合是可行的。
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.sourceTitle: Carbon-Convergent Co-utilization of Ethanol and CO2 Enables Efficient 3-Hydroxypropionic Acid Biosynthesis in Komagataella phaffii
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11458557/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract CO 2 is an abundant feedstock for biomanufacturing, but its high oxidation state demands substantial reducing power for multicarbon biosynthesis. Here, we establish a carbon-convergent strategy for producing 3-hydroxypropionic acid (3-HP) through the co-utilization of ethanol and inorganic carbon in engineered Komagataella phaffii. Ethanol serves as a nexus molecule that supplies a conserved C2 backbone together with reducing equivalents, enabling a "2+1=3" route to 3-HP through inorganic C1 incorporation. Coordinated engineering of ethanol assimilation, acetate activation, carboxylation, cofactor supply, and energy metabolism generated strain LT-28, which produced 127.04 g/L 3-HP, the highest titer reported so far for CO 2 -based biosynthesis. 13C tracing verified the joint contribution of ethanol-derived C2 carbon and inorganic C1 carbon to the product skeleton. LT-28 also converted an unpurified ethanol-rich stream from thermocatalytic CO2 reduction into 3-HP. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of coupling chemical CO 2 reduction with microbial 3-HP biosynthesis through ethanol-mediated carbon convergence.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.titleZh: 比较多组学揭示酵母源细胞外囊泡中保守的膜结构与代谢活性载荷的选择性富集
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.abstractZh: 细胞外囊泡（EV）是各生命界细胞间通讯的基本介质，但我们对其生物学的认识主要来自哺乳动物系统。相比之下，尽管酵母源细胞外囊泡（YDEV）有潜力成为可规模化、非致病性的生物技术与代谢工程平台，其特征仍缺乏充分研究。本研究将高产量分离流程与比较多组学相结合，界定了来自3个酵母物种、4个菌株的细胞外囊泡中的代谢活性载荷与膜组成：传统模式酵母酿酒酵母（Saccharomyces cerevisiae，SC）、非模式产油酵母 Rhodotorula toruloides（RT-88），以及解脂耶氏酵母（Yarrowia lipolytica）的野生型W29及其工程化衍生菌株Po1f。研究者采用切向流过滤结合超速离心，可重复地从所有菌株中分离出完整、由双层膜包裹的囊泡。尽管各菌株的囊泡产量存在显著差异，这些囊泡仍具有保守的纳米尺度形态。比较代谢组学揭示了不同代谢活性载荷的选择性富集，包括SC中的核苷酸代谢物、RT-88中的脂肪酸与酰基肉碱，以及解脂耶氏酵母菌株中特有的代谢物。值得注意的是，烟酰胺腺嘌呤二核苷酸（NAD⁺）在SC和RT-88的细胞外囊泡中富集，但在解脂耶氏酵母来源的囊泡中几乎不存在。这提示一种可能性：囊泡包封或可为这种本身不能透过膜的辅因子提供受保护的运输。与载荷组成的差异形成对照，比较脂质组学表明，所有菌株的囊泡膜结构总体保守，仅特定脂质类别及膜不饱和度谱发生定量层面的重塑。综合而言，这些发现支持这样一种组织原则：酵母源细胞外囊泡在维持保守膜结构的同时，选择性富集具有代谢活性的载荷，由此建立了一个比较框架，用于理解进化上具有多样性的酵母物种中的细胞外囊泡生物学。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.sourceTitle: Comparative Multi-omics Reveals Conserved Membrane Architecture and Selective Metabolic Cargo Enrichment Across Yeast-Derived Extracellular Vesicles
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761364.sourceAbstract: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are fundamental mediators of intercellular communication across all kingdoms of life, yet our understanding of EV biology has been derived predominantly from mammalian systems. In contrast, yeast-derived extracellular vesicles (YDEVs) remain poorly characterized despite their potential as scalable, non-pathogenic platforms for biotechnology and metabolic engineering. Here, we combined a high-yield isolation workflow with comparative multi-omics to define the metabolically active cargo and membrane composition of EVs derived from three yeast species and four strains: the conventional model yeast Saccharomyces cerevisiae (SC), the non-model oleaginous yeast Rhodotorula toruloides (RT-88), and two Yarrowia lipolytica strains, wild-type W29 and its engineered derivative Po1f. Using tangential flow filtration coupled with ultracentrifugation, we reproducibly isolated intact, bilayer-enclosed vesicles with conserved nanoscale morphology across all strains despite marked differences in EV yield. Comparative metabolomics revealed selective enrichment of distinct metabolically active cargo, including nucleotide metabolites in SC, fatty acids and acyl-carnitines in RT-88, and strain-specific metabolites within the Yarrowia isolates. Notably, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide (NAD⁺) was enriched in SC and RT-88 EVs but was nearly absent from Yarrowia-derived vesicles, raising the possibility that EV encapsulation may facilitate protected transport of this otherwise membrane-impermeable cofactor. In contrast to these differences in cargo composition, comparative lipidomics demonstrated a broadly conserved membrane architecture across all strains, with only quantitative remodeling of specific lipid classes and membrane unsaturation profiles. Together, these findings support an organizational principle in which yeast-derived extracellular vesicles preserve a conserved membrane architecture while selectively enriching metabolically active cargo, establishing a comparative framework for understanding EV biology across evolutionarily diverse yeast species.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.titleZh: 仿骨髓熔融静电直写支架重现幼红细胞岛，用于培养红细胞的高密度生物制造
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.abstractZh: 生物制造的细胞疗法正在给现代医学带来显著进步，但高成本阻碍了其广泛应用。培养红细胞（cRBC）是一类正处于临床试验阶段、拟用于即用型输血的细胞治疗产品；然而，一次输血所需的数万亿个红细胞（RBC）的制造成本极高，仍然限制着其应用。如果培养平台能够像骨髓中那样，以更高密度培养细胞，使每个细胞所需的培养基更少、昂贵生长因子的使用浓度更低，则可能降低这些成本。研究者通过熔融静电直写（MEW）制造聚己内酯（PCL）支架，使其几何形状模仿骨髓中的骨小梁结构，随后经等离子体处理，以支持外周血单个核细胞（PB MNC）附着。PB MNC中的单核细胞首先黏附于支架，并迅速分化为CD68⁺巨噬细胞样细胞。这些负载巨噬细胞的支架进一步黏附CD71⁺幼红细胞；在红系诱导培养条件下，幼红细胞的比例从第4天的10%增加至第8天的25%，并在第20天产生CD235a⁺红系细胞。与传统的MEW交叉网格几何形状相比，仿骨小梁几何形状的MEW PCL支架具有更大的表面积，可黏附更多巨噬细胞，并生成更多幼红细胞。MEW支架持续将黏附性较弱的细胞释放到培养上清中；在细胞接种数量与培养基体积相同的条件下，其上清细胞数比液体悬浮培养对照增加74%。高细胞密度支架表现出更活跃的代谢，并内源性产生支持自身生长的细胞因子，这可能为未来通过优化培养基降低成本提供机会。本研究报告了仿骨髓骨小梁结构的MEW PCL设计，能够选择性黏附外周血单个核细胞，形成覆盖巨噬细胞的支架，为培养红细胞的生产提供物理与旁分泌支持。这一高细胞密度培养平台可能适用于未来的细胞治疗生物制造流程。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.sourceTitle: Marrow-mimicry MEW scaffolds recapitulate erythroblastic islands for high-density cRBC biomanufacturing
doi:10.64898/2026.10.23.761469.sourceAbstract: Biomanufactured cell therapies are delivering a step-change in modern medicine, but their high costs have prevented widespread adoption. Cultured red blood cells (cRBCs) are one type of cell therapy in clinical trials for off-the-shelf blood transfusion but remain limited by the exorbitant costs of manufacturing trillions of RBCs required for a blood transfusion. These costs could be mitigated if culture platforms could grow cells at higher density, like those found in the bone marrow, requiring less media and lower concentrations of expensive growth factors per cell. We engineered melt electrowritten (MEW) polycaprolactone (PCL) scaffolds in geometries which imitate marrow trabeculae structures and were then plasma-treated to enable peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PB MNC) attachment. PB MNC monocytes first adhered to the scaffold and rapidly differentiated into CD68 + macrophage-like cells. These macrophage-loaded scaffolds adhered CD71 + erythroblasts, which then grew from 10 to 25% between days 4 and 8 and produced CD235a + erythroid cells by day 20, under erythrogenic culture conditions. MEW PCL scaffolds in trabecular-like geometries had greater surface area, adhered more macrophages, and generated more erythroblasts than traditional MEW crosshatch geometries. The MEW scaffolds continuously released less-adherent cells to the supernatant, providing a 74% increase in supernatant cell numbers versus liquid suspension controls with identical cell seeding numbers and media volumes. High-cell-density scaffolds exhibited increased metabolism and endogenous production of self-supportive cytokines, which may offer cost-saving opportunities through future media optimisation. This study reports marrow trabeculae-mimetic MEW PCL designs capable of selectively adhering PB MN cells to develop macrophage-coated scaffolds, which provided physical and paracrine support for cRBC production. This high-cell-density culture platform may be useful for future cell therapy biomanufacturing protocols.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.titleZh: 遗传控制将不依赖TGFβ的多能干细胞自我更新与跨胚层的确定性正向编程相耦合
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.abstractZh: 要可重复、可规模化地制造人诱导多能干细胞（hiPSC）衍生细胞，需要控制其扩增与分化。转录因子介导的正向编程可使hiPSC分化受到遗传控制，但扩增仍依赖外源补充生长因子，从而增加工艺复杂性及对操作者的依赖。本研究提出GERALT，即遗传增强的自我更新与自主谱系转分化（Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation）。这是一种通过靶向安全港位点整合而组装的推拉式基因回路，将由NANOG支持、不依赖TGFβ的自我更新，与多西环素诱导的谱系编程及同步发生的NANOG沉默相耦合。在长时间撤除TGFβ的条件下，GERALT在贴壁培养与悬浮培养中均能维持多能性，同时仍可被编程为肌源性、神经元及肝细胞命运。在肌生成方面，与已建立的OPTi-OX平台相比，GERALT能够在简化培养基中实现分化，同时使命运决定过程更加定向并加快这一过程。GERALT还支持在悬浮培养中直接进行肌源性编程，并能将hiPSC直接浇注到水凝胶中，随后在组织内进行编程，获得能够对电刺激作出反应的工程化肌肉组织。这些结果将遗传控制向上游延伸至干细胞自我更新，有助于新方法学（new approach methodologies）及其他生物制造应用的实施。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.sourceTitle: Genetic control couples TGFβ-independent pluripotent stem cell renewal to deterministic forward programming across germ layers
doi:10.64898/2026.10.25.761636.sourceAbstract: Reproducible and scalable manufacture of human induced pluripotent stem cell (hiPSC) derivatives requires control over expansion and differentiation. Transcription factor-mediated forward programming can place hiPSC differentiation under genetic control, but expansion still relies on extracellular growth-factor supplementation, increasing process complexity and operator dependence. Here we introduce GERALT (Genetically Enhanced Renewal and Autonomous Lineage Transdifferentiation), a push-pull genetic circuit assembled through targeted safe-harbour integration that couples NANOG-supported, TGFβ-independent renewal to doxycycline-inducible lineage programming and simultaneous NANOG silencing. GERALT maintained pluripotency during extended TGFβ withdrawal in both adherent and suspension culture, yet remained programmable towards myogenic, neuronal, and hepatic fates. Compared with the established OPTi-OX platform in myogenesis, GERALT enabled differentiation in simplified medium while canalising and accelerating commitment. GERALT also supported direct myogenic programming in suspension and enabled direct casting of hiPSCs into hydrogel followed by in-tissue programming, yielding electrically responsive engineered muscle tissues. These results extend genetic control upstream into stem cell renewal, facilitating deployment of new approach methodologies and other biomanufacturing applications.

doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.titleZh: 高通量蛋白质相互作用组分析揭示LSD1通过病毒核衣壳蛋白赖氨酸去甲基化调控SARS-CoV-2产生
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.abstractZh: 在生理条件下，高通量鉴定蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）并对其成像，仍是一项重大挑战。同时，SARS-CoV-2核衣壳（N）蛋白是含量最高的病毒蛋白，在病毒产生中发挥关键作用。为增进对病毒机制的认识并支持抗病毒开发，研究者使用拆分的miRFP670nano3，开发了亮度最高且体积最小的近红外双分子荧光互补（NIR-BiFC）系统。通过将该系统与新一代测序（NGS）相整合，研究者建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq，用于高通量绘制蛋白质相互作用组。应用这一方法，研究者系统考察了SARS-CoV-2 N蛋白与宿主细胞蛋白之间的相互作用。结果揭示，赖氨酸特异性去甲基化酶1（LSD1）使N蛋白第233位赖氨酸（K233）去甲基化，从而通过增强N蛋白的多种功能促进病毒产生。这些功能包括N蛋白二聚化、与Nsp12相互作用、与病毒RNA结合，以及液-液相分离（LLPS）。值得注意的是，靶向K233位点的抑制剂显著抑制了SARS-CoV-2的产生。本研究建立了NIR-BiFC-Seq这一用于相互作用组绘制的灵敏合成生物学平台，并将LSD1介导的调控机制确定为有前景的抗病毒治疗靶点。
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.sourceTitle: High-throughput protein interactome identifies LSD1 as a regulator of SARS-CoV-2 production through lysine demethylation of viral nucleocapsid protein.
doi:10.1016/j.mcpro.2026.101695.sourceAbstract: High-throughput identification and imaging of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) under physiological conditions remains a significant challenge. Concurrently, the SARS-CoV-2 nucleocapsid (N) protein, the most abundant viral protein, plays an essential role in viral production. To advance the understanding of viral mechanisms and support antiviral development, we developed the brightest and smallest near-infrared bimolecular fluorescence complementation (NIR-BiFC) system using split miRFP670nano3. By integrating this system with next-generation sequencing (NGS), we established NIR-BiFC-Seq for the high-throughput mapping of protein interactomes. Applying this method, we systematically investigated interactions between the SARS-CoV-2 N protein and host cellular proteins. Our findings reveal that lysine-specific demethylase-1 (LSD1) demethylates the N protein at lysine 233 (K233), thereby enhancing viral production through the potentiation of multiple N protein functions. These include N protein dimerization, interaction with Nsp12, binding to viral RNA, and liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS). Notably, inhibitors targeting the K233 site significantly suppressed SARS-CoV-2 production. This study establishes NIR-BiFC-Seq as a sensitive synthetic biology platform for interactome mapping and identifies LSD1-mediated regulatory mechanisms as promising targets for antiviral therapy.

doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.titleZh: 小基因组，大启示：病毒如何帮助我们认识基于结构的RNA调控
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.abstractZh: RNA病毒在同一分子中编码多层信息，该分子既是蛋白质合成的模板，也作为具有特定结构的调控性RNA发挥作用。这些结构控制病毒基因表达的关键环节，调节与宿主的相互作用，并介导免疫逃逸。尽管RNA结构在病毒基因组中的普遍存在已得到充分认识，但直到最近，功能与机制研究才开始揭示这些元件如何作为调控模块影响感染结局。RNA病毒具有紧凑的基因组和便于开展实验研究的生命周期，因此成为有力的模式系统，可用于揭示RNA调控的基本构成要素，以及真核生物中保守的基因控制原则。本文综述了目前对不同病毒科中基于RNA结构的调控机制的认识，并将其与真核生物转录组中由结构介导的基因控制进行对照，强调RNA结构是基因表达的一个核心调控层面，在治疗与合成生物学方面具有广泛潜力。
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.sourceTitle: Small genomes, big lessons: What viruses teach us about structure-based riboregulation.
doi:10.1016/j.molcel.2026.10.001.sourceAbstract: RNA viruses encode multiple layers of information within a single molecule, which functions simultaneously as a template for protein synthesis and as a structured regulatory RNA. These structures control key aspects of viral gene expression, govern host interactions, and mediate immune evasion. Although the prevalence of RNA structure in viral genomes is now well established, only recently have functional and mechanistic studies begun to uncover how these elements act as regulatory modules that shape infection outcomes. With their compact genomes and experimentally tractable life cycles, RNA viruses represent powerful model systems for uncovering the fundamental building blocks of riboregulation and illuminating principles of gene control conserved across eukaryotes. Here, we review current mechanistic understanding of RNA structure-based regulation across diverse viral families and draw parallels to structure-mediated gene control in eukaryotic transcriptomes, highlighting RNA structure as a central regulatory layer in gene expression with broad therapeutic and synthetic biology potential.

doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.titleZh: PrimeStack编辑器实现植物中大型多基因载荷的高效、位点特异性整合
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.abstractZh: 将大型DNA序列精确、定点地整合到植物基因组中，是作物生物技术和合成生物学长期追求的目标，但随机插入、同源重组效率低以及基因靶向方面的限制仍然存在。本研究提出PrimeStack，这是一种不依赖双链断裂（DSB）的平台，将先导编辑（PE）与单向大型丝氨酸整合酶Bxb1相结合，并利用进化所得的变体增强活性，从而在水稻（Oryza sativa）预先指定的基因组安全港（GSH）中，实现多基因、数千碱基载荷的可编程插入。优化后的先导编辑器首先以高保真性建立具有高遗传性的attP着陆位点，随后通过Bxb1介导的重组，实现遗传信息的不可逆整合。根据连接位点特异性PCR分析，PrimeStack在再生水稻植株中实现了大型载荷的定点整合，效率最高达45%。在所评估的条件下，移栽入土5周后，未观察到这些植株与野生型（WT）植株之间存在明显的形态学差异。研究者通过在一个经实验确认的基因组安全港中定点插入类胡萝卜素基因盒，验证了该平台的实用性。PrimeStack提供了模块化、位点特异性的基因堆叠平台，使基因组安全港中的多基因性状聚合与途径构建具有可预测性，从而加快改良型、抗逆作物品种的开发，并推动可规模化的植物生物制造及强大合成生物学底盘的构建。
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.sourceTitle: PrimeStack editors enable efficient and site-specific integration of large multigene cargos in plants.
doi:10.1371/journal.pbio.3003778.sourceAbstract: Precise, site-specific integration of large DNA sequences into plant genomes is a long-standing goal of crop biotechnology and synthetic biology, yet remains constrained by random insertion, inefficient homologous recombination, and gene targeting. Here, we present PrimeStack, a DSB-independent platform that integrates PE with the unidirectional large serine integrase Bxb1, leveraging evolved variants for enhanced activity, to achieve the programmable insertion of multigene, multikilobase cargos at predefined genomic safe harbors (GSH) in rice (Oryza sativa). Optimized prime editors first install attP landing sites with high fidelity and heritability followed by Bxb1-mediated recombination that generates irreversible integration of genetic information. PrimeStack enabled targeted large-cargo integration in regenerated rice plants with efficiencies of up to 45%, as determined by junction-specific PCR analyses. No obvious morphological differences from WT plants were observed at 5 weeks after transfer to soil under the evaluated conditions. We validate its utility by achieving targeted insertion of a carotenoid cassette at an experimentally confirmed genomic safe harbor. PrimeStack delivers a modular, site-specific gene stacking platform that enables predictable, multigene trait pyramiding and pathway construction at GSH, thereby accelerating the development of improved and resilient crop varieties, as well as scalable plant-based biomanufacturing and a powerful chassis for synthetic biology.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.titleZh: 工程化益生菌靶向肉芽肿，用于治疗分枝杆菌感染
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.abstractZh: 肉芽肿是分枝杆菌的一种病理性生存微环境，常规疗法仍难以到达。本研究表明，益生菌大肠杆菌Nissle 1917（Escherichia coli Nissle 1917，EcN）能够浸润并定植于肉芽肿，还可被改造成感知局部微环境并释放抗分枝杆菌载荷的递送系统。具体而言，研究者利用坏死性肉芽肿的低氧微环境限制细菌生长，并开发了结合细胞内与细胞外杀伤的双模式裂解回路，以实现载荷持续释放，同时限制进化逃逸。研究者进一步改造EcN，使其表达一种来源于分枝杆菌噬菌体的酶，获得的菌株在体外抑制了药物敏感型和耐药型分枝杆菌，并增强了常规抗生素的活性。工程化益生菌还降低了体内分枝杆菌负荷；在利福平耐药感染的小鼠模型中，与pretomanid联合治疗实现的菌量下降幅度大于任一单药治疗。这些结果共同建立了一个利用可编程活微生物靶向肉芽肿性感染的合成生物学框架。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.sourceTitle: Engineered probiotics target granulomas to treat mycobacterial infection
doi:10.64898/2026.10.27.762313.sourceAbstract: Granulomas are a pathological niche for mycobacteria that remain difficult to access with conventional therapies. Here we show that probiotic Escherichia coli Nissle 1917 (EcN) infiltrates and colonizes granulomas and can be engineered as a delivery system that senses the local microenvironment and releases antimycobacterial payloads. Specifically, we leveraged the hypoxic microenvironment of necrotic granulomas to restrict bacterial growth, and developed a dual-mode lysis circuit combining intracellular and extracellular killing for sustained payload release with limited evolutionary escape. We further engineered EcN to express a mycobacteriophage-derived enzyme, generating a strain that suppressed drug-sensitive and drug-resistant mycobacteria in vitro and potentiated conventional antibiotic activity. Engineered probiotics also reduced mycobacterial burden in vivo, and in a murine model of rifampicin-resistant infection, combination treatment with pretomanid achieved greater bacterial reduction than either monotherapy. Together, these results establish a synthetic biology framework for targeting granulomatous infections with programmable living microbes.

doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.titleZh: 细胞生物学与生物工程交汇处的新方法学：类器官与器官芯片
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.abstractZh: 包括类器官和器官芯片（OOC）在内的新方法学（NAM）的快速发展，凸显了细胞生物学家与生物工程师开展跨学科对话的必要性，以开发最能辅助治疗手段研发的人源模型。干细胞来源及生物工程构建的人体组织模型正在重塑人们对人体生理与病理生理的理解，并提供传统临床前模型所不能实现的可控性。通过再现复杂组织微环境、多器官相互作用及患者个体特异性的生物学特征，这些系统正在弥合药物研发与临床应用流程中长期存在的缺口。本文综合梳理了类器官、器官芯片及其他用于转化医学的生物工程技术的进展，以识别仍然存在的不足，包括可重复性、验证及监管认可方面的挑战。合成生物学、多组学、机器学习与基因工程交叉领域涌现的机遇，正推动新方法学不仅成为改进的实验工具，也成为加快治疗手段发现、支持规模化个体化医疗的基础平台。
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.sourceTitle: Organoids and organs-on-a-chip as new approach methodologies at the convergence of cell biology and bioengineering.
doi:10.1016/j.stem.2026.10.003.sourceAbstract: The rapid growth of new approach methodologies (NAMs), including organoids and organs-on-a-chip (OOCs), has revealed a need for interdisciplinary dialogue between cell biologists and bioengineers to develop human models that can best complement therapeutic development. Stem cell-derived and bioengineered human tissue models are redefining how we understand human physiology and pathophysiology, offering control that traditional preclinical models cannot provide. By recapitulating complex tissue microenvironments, multi-organ interactions, and patient-specific biology, these systems are bridging long-standing gaps in the drug development and clinical application pipelines. Here, we synthesize advances in organoids, OOCs, and other bioengineered technologies for translational medicine to identify remaining gaps, including challenges in reproducibility, validation, and regulatory acceptance. Emerging opportunities at the intersection of synthetic biology, multi-omics, machine learning, and genetic engineering are positioning NAMs not merely as improved experimental tools but as foundational platforms for accelerating therapeutic discovery and enabling personalized medicine at scale.

doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.titleZh: 人工细胞与仿生细胞：推动药物发现和递送范式转变的智能系统
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.abstractZh: 合成生物学、材料科学与人工智能的融合正推动生物制药研究发生变革，使其从被动药物载体发展为智能、可编程的治疗系统。本综述将人工细胞与仿生细胞作为连接基础生物学发现和临床转化的框架进行评估，并考察了5条关键技术路径：膜工程化人工细胞、无膜细胞器（MLO）系统、多区室人工细胞、原始细胞通讯网络及虚拟细胞。这些平台能够精确调控药物稳定性、靶向性、生物合成及适应性响应能力。近期进展包括微环境触发释放、逻辑门控的细胞间通讯，以及虚拟细胞辅助的高通量筛选和毒性预测。尽管取得这些进展，可规模化制造、长期稳定性及监管适配仍面临挑战。将闭环学习、可解释模型与先进生物制造相整合，将是推动人工细胞与仿生细胞系统走向下一代精准医学前沿的关键。
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.sourceTitle: Artificial Cells and Biomimetic Cells: Intelligent Systems Driving a Paradigm Shift in Drug Discovery and Delivery.
doi:10.1002/adhm.71906.sourceAbstract: The convergence of synthetic biology, materials science, and artificial intelligence drives a transformative shift in biopharmaceutical research, advancing from passive drug carriers to intelligent, programmable therapeutics. This review evaluates artificial and biomimetic cells as a framework that connects fundamental biological discovery with clinical translation. It examines five key technological pathways: membrane-engineered artificial cells, membraneless organelle (MLO) systems, multicompartmental artificial cells, protocell communication networks, and virtual cells. These platforms enable precise regulation of drug stability, targeting, biosynthesis, and adaptive responsiveness. Recent progress includes microenvironment-triggered release, logic-gated intercellular communication, and virtual cell-assisted high-throughput screening and toxicity prediction. Despite these advances, challenges remain in scalable manufacturing, long-term stability, and regulatory adaptation. The integration of closed-loop learning, interpretable models, and advanced biomanufacturing will be essential to position artificial and biomimetic cell systems at the forefront of next-generation precision medicine.

doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.titleZh: 通过大肠杆菌代谢工程增强L-丝氨酸生物合成
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.abstractZh: 摘要：L-丝氨酸是一种重要的非必需氨基酸，广泛应用于食品、制药、饲料和化妆品行业。然而，以往关于大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）发酵生产L-丝氨酸的研究主要着眼于提高滴度，对转化得率关注不足，限制了其工业生产的经济可行性。本研究开展系统性代谢工程改造，以提高L-丝氨酸得率。以H5为亲本菌株，利用CRISPR/Cas9系统删除与L-丝氨酸再摄取相关的基因sstT和tdcC，获得菌株H8，其L-丝氨酸滴度提高至5.58 g/L，转化得率达到0.37 g/g。随后，分别增强H8中的L-丝氨酸生物合成模块、L-丝氨酸转运模块和辅因子供应模块，获得重组菌株H8-abc、H8-be和H8-pntab。这3株菌的L-丝氨酸滴度分别为6.40、5.89和5.59 g/L，相应得率分别为0.43、0.39和0.37 g/g。进一步将有效策略组合到H8底盘中，获得菌株H8-abc-be，但其L-丝氨酸产量下降。最后，研究者选择H8-abc进行发酵培养基优化。优化后，摇瓶发酵的L-丝氨酸滴度达到7.20 g/L，得率为0.48 g/g，相比起始菌株H5提高71.84%。这些结果为开发用于工业化生产L-丝氨酸的高效大肠杆菌菌株提供了有用参考。
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance L-serine biosynthesis
doi:10.21203/rs.3.rs-11324733/v1.sourceAbstract: Abstract L-serine, an important non-essential amino acid, is widely used in the food, pharmaceutical, feed, and cosmetic industries. However, previous studies on fermentative L-serine production by Escherichia coli have mainly focused on improving titer, whereas insufficient attention has been paid to the conversion yield, limiting its industrial economic feasibility. In this study, systematic metabolic engineering was performed to improve L-serine yield. Using H5 as the parental strain, the L-serine re-uptake-related genes sstT and tdcC were deleted based on the CRISPR/Cas9 system to generate strain H8, in which the L-serine titer increased to 5.58 g/L and the conversion yield reached 0.37 g/g. Subsequently, the L-serine biosynthetic module, L-serine transport module, and cofactor supply module were individually enhanced in H8, resulting in recombinant strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab , respectively. The resulting strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab produced 6.40, 5.89, and 5.59 g/L L-serine, with yields of 0.43, 0.39, and 0.37 g/g, respectively. Further combination of effective strategies in the H8 chassis generated strain H8- abc-be ; however, its L-serine production decreased. Finally, H8- abc was selected for fermentation medium optimization. After optimization, the L-serine titer reached 7.20 g/L in shake-flask fermentation, with a yield of 0.48 g/g, representing a 71.84% increase compared with the starting strain H5. These results provide a useful reference for the development of efficient E. coli strains for industrial L-serine production.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.titleZh: 极端嗜热细菌Anaerocellum bescii的CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑系统开发
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.abstractZh: Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）是一种极端嗜热的厌氧细菌，最适温度（Topt）为75—78 °C；它还能够高效降解木质纤维素，因此有望成为代谢工程平台。迄今为止，A. bescii的染色体遗传操作需要通过整合型载体介导的同源重组和反向筛选等多步骤程序完成。本研究借助来自Geobacillus stearothermophilus的热稳定Cas9酶（GeoCas9），首次在A. bescii中实现了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑。通过可复制载体递送异源CRISPR系统，研究者能够在A. bescii中分别及依次删除乳酸脱氢酶基因（ldh）和pyrE。随后，研究者利用该系统删除一个新的靶标——色氨酸合酶基因（trpBA），获得了A. bescii的色氨酸营养缺陷型菌株。利用这一菌株，研究者表明，trpBA互补可支持对表达异源酶类报告基因的可复制载体进行筛选和维持。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.sourceTitle: Development of a CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system for the extremely thermophilic bacterium Anaerocellum bescii
doi:10.64898/2026.10.26.761776.sourceAbstract: Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor) bescii is an extremely thermophilic (Topt 75-78 °C) anaerobic bacterium and is also a highly efficient degrader of lignocellulose, making it a promising platform for metabolic engineering. To date, chromosomal genetic manipulations in A. bescii have required multistep procedures involving homologous recombination with integrating vectors and counterselection. Here, we demonstrate the first implementation of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in A. bescii facilitated by a thermostable Cas9 enzyme from Geobacillus stearothermophilus (GeoCas9). Delivery of heterologous CRISPR machinery via a replicating vector enabled us to individually and sequentially delete genes for lactate dehydrogenase (ldh) and pyrE in A. bescii. We then deployed this system to delete a novel target, tryptophan synthase (trpBA), generating a tryptophan auxotrophic strain of A. bescii. Using this strain, we show trpBA complementation enables selection and maintenance of a replicating vector expressing a heterologous enzymatic reporter gene.

doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.titleZh: 代谢知识引导的生物反应器模型：将补料分批工艺的知识迁移至连续生物制造
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞仍是单克隆抗体（mAb）制造的主要平台，不断增长的需求正推动该行业从补料分批运行转向连续运行。连续培养有望维持高细胞密度和高体积生产率，但其运行依赖可靠的实时监测、预测与控制。细胞内状态的可观测性有限，细胞外测量又较为稀疏，阻碍了这一目标的实现，使机制认识与预测模型的实际部署之间持续存在差距。本研究提出一种由代谢知识引导的mAb生产模型，将反应器层面和细胞内层面的质量衡算直接嵌入学习架构，同时避免预设动力学速率定律和显式稳态假设。由于守恒关系在不同运行模式下保持不变，这一表述为跨工况泛化提供了基于原理的结构先验，并将模型定位为连续生物过程的软传感器：推断未测量的细胞内通量，并提前一步预测细胞外浓度，以支持过程监测和控制。研究者对两种代谢网络规模与三种代谢优化策略进行了基准比较，发现不同网络规模下的浓度预测结果无可区分的差异。交换通量的保真度与求解器选择无关，网络规模仅影响细胞内过程的可解释性。将所开发的模型从补料分批运行迁移至连续运行时，微调的表现优于其他迁移学习方案。这与代谢结构不随运行模式改变的认识一致。预测通量显示，补料分批培养中的生长速率，而非运行模式，是代谢变化的主导维度；模型还识别出可能提示工况转换的信号，可为连续培养表征的实验设计提供指导。这些结果为构建既充分建立在第一性原理知识之上、又能适应工况转换下部署的数字模型提供了一条路径。
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.sourceTitle: Metabolism-Informed Bioreactor Model for Transferring Knowledge from Fed-batch to Continuous Biomanufacturing
doi:10.64898/2026.10.28.762476.sourceAbstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells remain the dominant platform for monoclonal antibody (mAb) manufacturing, and rising demand is pushing the industry from fed-batch toward continuous operation. Continuous cultures promise sustained high cell densities and volumetric productivities, but their operation depends on reliable real-time monitoring, prediction and control. Limited intracellular observability and sparse extracellular measurements hinder this, leaving a persistent gap between mechanistic understanding and predictive deployment. Here we describe a metabolism-informed model for mAb production that embeds reactor- and intracellular-level mass balances directly within a learning architecture, while deliberately avoiding predefined kinetic rate laws and explicit steady-state assumptions. Because conservation relationships remain invariant across operating modes, this formulation provides a principled structural prior for cross-regime generalisation, positioning the model as a soft sensor for continuous bioprocesses: inferring unmeasured intracellular fluxes and one-step ahead forecasting extracellular concentrations to support process monitoring and control. Benchmarking two metabolic network sizes and three metabolic optimisation strategies, concentration predictions are indistinguishable across network sizes. Exchange flux fidelity is agnostic to solver choice, with network size mattering only for intracellular interpretability. Transferring the developed model from fed-batch to continuous operation with fine-tuning outperforming other transfer learning variants. This is consistent with the metabolic structure being invariant to mode of operation. Predicted fluxes reveal growth rate in fed-batch, rather than operating mode, as the dominant axis of metabolic variation, and identify potential regime-shift signals to guide experimental design for continuous culture characterisation. These results chart a route towards digital models sufficiently grounded in first-principles knowledge, yet adaptive for deployment under regime shifts.
